sn22.18:1.6: The cause and reason that gives rise to feeling is also impermanent.
sn22.18:1.7: Since feeling is produced by what is impermanent, it cannot be permanent.
sn22.18:1.10: The cause and reason that gives rise to choices is also impermanent.
sn22.18:1.11: Since choices are produced by what is impermanent, they cannot be permanent.
